Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! Mom! Mom! Mom! Mom! Mom! Mom!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (mutters)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, if you're not paying attention, we're having... chocolate donuts for dinner.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (does not look up) Sounds good.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Ah, don't distract her, Candace. She was up all night trying to finish this book for her book club. But if we're having donuts, let's get the glazed ones, too. Ha!

Name: Adyson's Mom
Dialog: Linda Flynn-Fletcher!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Samantha Sweetwater! And hello, Adyson.

Name: Adyson
Dialog: Hi!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Samantha, I know our book club meets tomorrow, but... The Lengthiest & Most Thorough Adventures of Lord Ramblington is really long, and I don't think I can finish it.

Name: Samantha
Dialog: Oh, there's always a way, Linda. Take me, for instance. I just love to sit outside on my reading hammock and get lost in the pages. You just need to focus. The book is down here.

Name: Linda
Dialog: I feel terrible saying this...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Do it!

Name: Linda
Dialog: But I've always suspected Samantha doesn't read the books even though she says she does.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ooh! Spill the tea, Mom!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Look! The Lengthiest & Most Thorough Adventures of Lord Ramblington has been made into a movie.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (taking Dad's phone) And it opens tomorrow. (gasps) I bet Sweetwater will go see it and say she read the book. And if you do something like triangulate her movements against the movie schedule, you could bust her no prob.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (laughs) It's all so ridiculous. Who cares if Samantha read the book or not?

Name: Samantha
Dialog: Looks like you have sixteen items in the "15 items or less" lane, Linda.

Name: Cashier
Dialog: Yeah, what ya tryin' ta pull, lady? Get outta here.

Name: Samantha
Dialog: Ooh, busted!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (to Candace) I will do whatever you say.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, Mom.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (cont'd) Before I take you through my six-step plan to using this model of our neighborhood, I'd like to go over some pre-busting basics.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Honey, normally, I'd prefer you put this energy into something more... productive...

Name: Linda
Dialog: (cont'd) ...but today, I'm excited to spend the whole day with you!

Name: Candace
Dialog: The whole day doing exactly what I say! Okay, to get you into the mindset...

Name: Candace
Dialog: (cont'd) ...sometimes I get what I call a "busting tingle".

Name: Candace
Dialog: The feeling that the, uh, bust is a-brewin'. Phones down! I need you to take this seriously, Mother! Now raise your right hand. You're gonna take the Busting Oath.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (raises Linda's right hand for her) "I do solemnly swear..." Come on, Mom!

Name: Linda
Dialog: I do solemnly swear... (The house rumbles.) Do you hear that? It sounds like someone is building something, like, in our yard.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ugh! (slaps herself) There are too many distractions around here! Let's just get out in the field. Here, take this big bag of busting basics.

Name: Linda
Dialog: "Busting basics"?

Name: Candace
Dialog: You know, you know. Disguises, lip balm, sledgehammer. (pushes her mom out the door) Let's go, go, go, go, go, go, go!

Name: Candace
Dialog: So, as I was about to explain... Seatbelts, Mom!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, right! (buckles up)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Step one is intel. Like does Mrs. Sweetwater's book look like it's been read? We're heading to her house now.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No phone! Do what I say! Now, I happen to know that Adyson has an archery lesson at noon, and Mrs. Sweetwater will drive her there.

Name: Linda
Dialog: And how do you know that?

Name: Adyson
Dialog: On Thursdays, I have archery lessons at noon! My mom drives me!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (uninterested) Cool story, Adyson.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mrs. Sweetwater should've left her house by 11:45, so the coast will be clear.

Name: Linda
Dialog: What is that on the road? Guacamole? That's something you don't see every—

Name: Candace
Dialog: Focus, Mom!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Is this guacamole?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Make use of your surroundings. Keep up, Mom!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, Sweetwater let us know she likes to read outside, and... Bingo! There's the book.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ugh! You and your phone! (takes the phone) I'm turning this thing off! (She does so.) Here. (Gives Mom a pair of binoculars.) You look through these and tell me what you see.

Name: Linda
Dialog: I don't...

Name: Linda
Dialog: Ooh! That's better. Very interesting.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (gasps) What's the intel?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Samantha's roses are coming in so nicely.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, Mom! The book!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Okay, hmmm... (gasps) The book spine is barely cracked and the bookmark is only a few pages in.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes! So we know she hasn't read it!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What?

Name: Linda
Dialog: That's pretty impressive, honey!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, what do you mean?

Name: Linda
Dialog: You've really developed some skills!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Thanks! I've had a lot of practice.

Name: Irving
Dialog: Candace? Candace's Mom? Is that you?

Name: Irving
Dialog: What are you guys doing down there?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ugh! Irving, keep quiet! Wait! That treehouse could be a good vantage point for my step two. Irving, you're on the team!

Name: Irving
Dialog: (gasps) Finally!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, climb up.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Is this really what you go through every day? It's a little intense.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Welcome to my world.

Name: Man
Dialog: Hey!

Name: Irving
Dialog: What a coincidence! I was just pursuing my scrapbook of every invention your—

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, yeah, yeah. That's great, Irving.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, look at that giant balloon dancey-guy thing. That's really something. That's gotta be 500 feet tall. I wonder who—

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, pay attention!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Raise your arms.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Step two: infiltrate!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Whoa! Now what?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Step three: investigate! Just scope the perimeter to find clues!

Name: Linda
Dialog: This is probably illegal. (looks down) Those roses really do look good. (gasps) Artificial? No. One bust at a time, Linda.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What? Sweetwater's back? What about Adyson's archery lesson?!

Name: Irving
Dialog: Rescheduled.

Name: Candace
Dialog: How do you know that?

Name: Adyson
Dialog: My Thursday archery lesson got rescheduled!

Name: Irving
Dialog: (happily) Cool story, Adyson!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Let's reel her back in!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, biscuits! What do I do now?!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Step four: improvise!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (yells)

Name: Irving
Dialog: Awkward...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Whoa!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Um, I'm not sure that rope will hold your combined...

Name: Irving
Dialog: ...body weights.

Name: Linda
Dialog: and **Candace**: Run!

Name: Linda
Dialog: I got a clue! As I was careening past her window, I saw Samantha checking movie schedules on her phone!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You did what I said and got a step three clue! Mom, are you getting the busting tingle?!

Name: Irving
Dialog: Ow.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, something's tingling, but I think it's this holly bush.

Name: Irving
Dialog: What's next, team?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Step five is initiate the bust! If Mrs. Sweetwater heads to the movie theater, we're golden!

Name: Irving
Dialog: (gasps) Smuggling in her own candy! Who is this woman?

Name: Candace
Dialog: She must be catching the matinee at the Danville Five.

Name: Linda
Dialog: We're so close! Let's go!

Name: Car salesman
Dialog: Aw, man, if only I had some huge, colorful, visual marketing gimmick to call attention to my car lot, maybe I wouldn't be goin' out of business.

Name: Car salesman
Dialog: (shakes Ferb's hand) You guys are lifesavers!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, there's that dancing guy thing again. Look at the size of it!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Eyes on the prize, Mom!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Suit up!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Honey, I can't believe I'm saying this, but IT'S BUSTING TIME!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I like your enthusiasm, but you gotta keep your head in the game. Sometimes, things can go—

Name: Linda
Dialog: (in Candace mode) C'mon, c'mon, c'mon, c'mon!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (gets out of the car) Okay, okay! (to herself) Jeez, am I like this?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Curse you, Perry the Platypus! (gasps)

Name: Car salesman
Dialog: (to Phineas and Ferb) Thanks, my business is saved! All I had to promote this thing was a bunch of dry chips. Somebody bought all the guacamole in town.

Name: Man
Dialog: Aw, man, I love chips and guac! Makes me wanna buy another car!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, there you are, Perry!

Name: Perry
Dialog: (chatters)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stay down, stay down. It's the element of surprise.

Name: Lord Ramblington
Dialog: (on screen) I've said this before and I'll say it again, repeatedly.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ready, Mom? (gasps) This is the big moment!

Name: Linda
Dialog: I'm ready! (giggles)

Name: Lord Ramblington
Dialog: I think about you every day. I awake to the very thought of you on my pillow, which fills...

Name: Lord Ramblington
Dialog: ...both my hours and my dreams.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hit the lights, Irving!

Name: Samantha
Dialog: Linda!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Huh?

Name: Samantha
Dialog: You're here!

Name: Baljeet's Mother
Dialog: Hey, you made it!

Name: Mrs. Garcia-Shapiro
Dialog: Hey, Linda!

Name: Samantha
Dialog: Hi, Linda, just in time! I saved you a seat.

Name: Linda
Dialog: I don't understand. The whole book club is here?

Name: Samantha
Dialog: Yes! Didn't you get our group text? None of us could finish the book, so we thought what the heck? Let's go see the movie instead.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Group text? (gasps; realizes) Oh, no! My phone!

Name: Linda
Dialog: But... but but but but but...

Name: Samantha
Dialog: Wait, if you didn't get our texts, Linda, did you come here to cheat? (smirks) You are so busted!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Yeah. I deserve that.

Name: Samantha
Dialog: Why are you wearing mustaches? (gasps) Oh, are you dressed as Lord Ramblington?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Yes. (takes mustache off) Yes, I was.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Thanks for a wonderful day, hon. You know, you really impressed me.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Does that mean tomorrow, we can bust the boys? Together?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, honey, shh. The movie is starting.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (sighs) Step six: inevitable failure.

Name: Lord Ramblington
Dialog: (on screen) We are worth fighting for. Together, we can be in love.

Name: Irving
Dialog: Wow, they weren't kidding. This dude really does ramble. (to Samantha) I bet the book is better.

Name: Samantha
Dialog: Oh, Irving, you know I never read the books.

Name: Irving
Dialog: Huh. How would I know that?

Name: Samantha
Dialog: I never read the books.

Name: Irving
Dialog: Ooh, cool story, Adyson's Mom!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: No, no, no!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Huh?

Name: C-Suit
Dialog: I'm Candace. Jeremy, where'd you go? I'm Candace.
